text:
anya: Heads-up — saw a repeating queue oscillation on eu-west GPU pool around 02:10–02:15 UTC. Throughput drops, backlog clears, then repeats.

sam: Quick peek: token/sec dipped ~8k -> 1.2k for ~40s. Concurrency spikes causing autoscaler to thrash. Might be batching + KV-cache eviction combo.

josh: Is this the same pulse we've seen with prefix-cache thrash earlier this quarter? Any redis/eviction correlation?

leena: Yes — redis eviction spikes at 02:09:30 in az1, and we see network RTT jump to ~120ms for ~30s.

capacity-bot: Sim note: with 20% long-tail (>10k tokens) requests, headroom goes negative in ~3m for current eu-west capacity config.

sam: This looks like a capacity-gap, not just autoscaler lag. Autoscaler scales nodes; container spinup + model load adds 50–80s which matches the pulse period.

anya: Proposed mitigations: 1) lower scale-up threshold to 65% queued/cpu for eu-west, 2) pre-warm fractional GPUs for 01:45–03:15 UTC, 3) increase batch max latency cap to reduce batch variability.

josh: Also: implement short-circuit fallback — route long-tail requests to a smaller quantized variant for 60s when an oscillation is detected. Better p95 at cost of some quality.

leena: I'll run a cost vs latency calc. Back-of-envelope: enabling fallback + prewarm ~= +4 GPU-hours/day for eu-west if on weekdays.

anya: Can someone run a reproduce bench? Use: ```./bench/run_sim --site eu-west --qps 1200 --tail-ratio 0.2 --long-tail 12000``` Capture tokens/sec, queue depth, schedule delay.

sam: Running now, will post results.

sam: Run complete: baseline tokens/sec median 7900, during pulse tokens/sec 1400, queue depth peak 420, mean scheduling delay 62s. Log excerpt:
```[02:10:05] enqueue=120 reqs/s served=18 reqs/s preemptions=3```

josh: Preemptible churn + network blip + cache eviction = perfect storm. Action items: A) emergency canary: route 15% traffic to eu-west-warm pool with prewarmed nodes, B) tweak autoscaler fast-path to add small immediate buffer, C) long-term: predictive padding for known shoulder windows.

leena: I'll prep cost breakdown and a commit proposal for dedicated fractional slots M–F 01:30–03:30 UTC.

anya: I'll add a pulse-detection alert: condition = tokens/sec drop >60% AND queue_depth rise >200 within 30s. Also document runbook steps (+slash command to route to warm pool). @oncall-infra please stand by for canary.

sam: :thumbsup: ack.

josh: ack.

leena: ack — will send formal proposal + numbers by EOD.

capacity-bot: Follow-up reminder — scheduled canary roll at 02:00 UTC tomorrow to validate mitigations. Tagging infra-oncall.
